results.title: France – Miscellaneous software development services and computer systems – Acquisition de solutions informatiques de gestion de base de données
unknowns: Bidder must provide its actual turnover declarations and professional references/capacity evidence.
Electronic submission/signature formalities must be followed exactly where required.
results.why: Live open CNRS software/database opportunity with authoritative 15 September 2026 noon deadline. DCE asks for turnover declarations but exposes no numeric minimum turnover threshold. It requests principal services/references rather than a fixed disqualifying reference count/value threshold, explicitly allows reliance on capacities of other economic operators with written commitment, and states companies under three years old may prove professional, technical and financial capacity by any means. Scope is directly software/data: database solutions, RDF graph imports, transversal visualisation/query tools and maintenance. No named mandatory vendor certification or hard local-incumbent restriction is established in the reviewed DCE.

results.title: Ireland – Request for Tenders for the Provision of Pharmacovigilance Safety Database and Case Management System
unknowns: Tenderer must satisfy the requirement for three relevant case studies comparable in nature, scale and complexity, including pharmacovigilance/medicines-safety or comparable regulatory technology experience.
Required security/operation certifications for the hosted solution and bidder-specific insurance levels must be evidenced.
Irish tax clearance or the applicable non-resident evidence must be available before award.
results.why: Strong EUR 1m regulated-software opportunity and the true tender deadline is 25 September, not the 11 September query date. Financial standing is framed as ability to pay debts rather than a numeric turnover floor, and non-resident tax evidence is contemplated. However three comparable case studies plus regulated-hosting/security evidence are material selection gates, so it cannot be GREEN without a proven partner/capability route.

results.title: Germany – Unterstützung der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit des attoworld-Teams
unknowns: Exact current submission deadline must be reconciled because retrieved procurement documents contain legacy 2022 dates.
Bidder/team must satisfy strict personal experience and reference requirements exposed in the participation documents, including named personnel evidence.
German-language and delivery-team requirements must be demonstrably covered.
results.why: The communications title is attractive, but the substantive participation pack contains hard personnel/reference evidence and the DCE deadline extraction is contaminated by legacy dates. This needs a capable German partner and deadline confirmation before it can be treated as actionable.

results.title: Slovenia – Maintenance of SIMONE system for a period of four years
results.buyer: PLINOVODI, Družba za upravljanje s prenosnim sistemom, d.o.o.
blockers: Scope is four-year maintenance of the existing SIMONE Offline/Online gas-transmission operational system, including real-time redundant operation at primary and backup locations.
This is specialized critical-infrastructure incumbent-system maintenance rather than a greenfield lean software build.
unknowns: Exact numeric turnover threshold is not resolved from the ESPD snippets, although reliance on other entities is allowed.
results.why: The deadline is clearly stated in the tender text, but the technical scope is highly specialized operational gas-transmission software maintenance and is not a credible lean SPM delivery without a specialist incumbent-class partner.
